exposure: Type of neuraxial anesthesia (Spinal vs. Epidural)
Women who underwent Cesarean delivery with epidural anesthesia
outcome: Risk of chronic low back pain
cohort: 40,057 primiparous women in Taiwan who gave birth between January 1, 2000 and December 31, 2013
finding: Cesarean delivery with epidural anesthesia was associated with a higher risk of chronic low back pain compared to vaginal delivery.
